descriptor.name: Zambia NSDI ZILMIS lot polygons
descriptor.scope: Public Zambia NSDI ZILMIS cadastral-reference lot polygons. Frozen Mongu packet records a bounded local count and independent native OID read for 241873 near the unchanged WUP locator. Qualification is limited to two passes over thirteen 0.001-degree cells plus required binding queries; no citywide completeness, legal title, survey accuracy, currentness or long-term GIS key continuity claim.

evidence: First-party purpose: https://www.map.gov.zm/arcgis/rest/services/NSDI_Vector/CadasterNew/MapServer/info/iteminfo?f=pjson explicitly describes the exact CadasterNew service as "Zambia national cadaster data and customary lots". The same service documents "Lots from ZILMIS"; layer 0 is esriGeometryPolygon and SDE.Lots.OBJECTID is its OID. See evidence/official-purpose.json and evidence/official-service-metadata.json.

Geographic scope: the frozen Mongu city packet and service review record count-checked bounded geometry retrieval and an independent exact native-ID read for 241873 at the unchanged WUP settlement locator, 23.1518886178753 E, 15.2698331723381 S. Prior attempt independently sampled two distinct source lots in thirteen 0.001-degree cells around this point. The official publisher states national Zambia scope; full city coverage remains unverified.
